definition: NecessaryAt m w x quantifies existence of one fixed individual over accessible worlds. NecessaryBeing additionally requires an actual witness. This is a de re possible-world surrogate, not an account of Kantian real possibility, duration, uncausedness, or Scott’s essence-based NE.
note: Analyst’s explicit reconstruction for the Kant inquiry (#250), not an assertion that the surrogate exhausts the historical concept. Source fidelity and the missing philosophical bridges are discussed in docs/kant-cosmological-inference.md.
